question:
Help me to compile a complete list of members of the government agency whose number of members was permanently determined after a major domestic conflict, which gained the power to review the legality of actions by other branches of government through an early significant legal dispute, and whose workplace is an iconic building embodying classical architectural ideals, who were successfully confirmed from President Richard Nixon’s first term through President Joe Biden’s term. For each member, record: Name, Position (Chief Justice or Associate Justice), Tenure Start Date(in the format as YYYY-MM-DD), Tenure End Date (enter “NA” for currently serving members as of the end of 2024), Nominating President, President’s Party Affiliation, Ideological Leaning (Conservative or Liberal), Most Recent Prior Position

Please output the organized data in Markdown table format. The column names in the table should be, in order: Name | Position | Tenure Start Date | Tenure End Date | Nominating President | President’s Party | Ideological Leaning | Previous Position

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is:
 ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
